after.capture_method: Process-local hooks on the unchanged native model, coefficient projection/tanh operands, and pre-output-RMS attention tensors; no duplicated layer loop or projection.
after.direction_jacobian_interpretation: Sensitivity of normalized factorial-coordinate direction to stored b/a/W; not the task-loss gradient or a score-weighted polynomial norm. Radius denominator is floored at 1e-12; the fraction affected is reported.

before.capture_method: Process-local hooks on the unchanged native model, coefficient projection/tanh operands, and pre-output-RMS attention tensors; no duplicated layer loop or projection.
before.direction_jacobian_interpretation: Sensitivity of normalized factorial-coordinate direction to stored b/a/W; not the task-loss gradient or a score-weighted polynomial norm. Radius denominator is floored at 1e-12; the fraction affected is reported.

bounded_repeatability_control.limits: Same fitted BF16 checkpoint and worst B8 fitting microbatch, no training or precision conversion. Exact repeatability is checked separately for every compiled program. The native coefficient-return API adds no hand-written generator statistics. Materialized-logit controls return additional arrays and may themselves compile differently from their NLL-anchor programs; their loss changes are recorded rather than conflated with the original discrepancy.

native_generator_change.limits: Before and after coefficients are captured from each generator's own causal native forward, so later-layer inputs also change. Parameter differences are accumulated changes, not Adam update estimates from gradient norms.

limits: Fixed-input fitting diagnostics with different source backbones. These are not held-out LM perplexities. Coefficient-space direction/Jacobian statistics do not directly measure attention-output or loss sensitivity; functional replay supplies the corresponding loss measurements.
